review_process: Parent owns acquisition/edits/Git/lock; separately prompted source_ra61, representation_ra61 and adversarial_ra61 on gpt-5.6-sol/ultra challenge source scope and data-only reuse. Exact final-head acceptance and publication state are recorded in the Git-local receipt. These reviews are correlated computation, not independent human or laboratory validation.

adjudications.objection: Methodol activity could be treated as sufficient evidence of a lysine-covalent pathway or isolated hydrophobic causality.
adjudications.evidence: Raymond2015 p564 controls, TableI; Figure8 non-turnover analogue.
adjudications.decision: Preserve positive C-terminal control activity and separate L105K analogue response. Residual activity is non-unique evidence; exact pathway, all-nucleophile absence and sole hydrophobic cause are not established.

adjudications.objection: C-terminal controls could inherit full-length identity or chemical acetylation could become a genetic mutation ratio.
adjudications.evidence: p564 cCaM lineage, p568 acetylation; Figure5 aliases.
adjudications.decision: Separate CaM/cCaM reference backgrounds; retain Ac-CaMWN chemical treatment and immediate preparation parent in source data. Request only CaMWN/cCaM and L105K/CaM genetic ratios; Ac endpoint remains in mechanistic context.

adjudications.objection: Figure5 conditions and triplicate measurements could fabricate exact protocol identity or an SD.
adjudications.evidence: TableI title and Methods p569 disagree with Figure5 caption on pH/buffer/range; plus/minus statistic unspecified.
adjudications.decision: Qualify only TableI/Methods within-table comparison; preserve conflict, unspecified temperature/error kind, and no propagated uncertainty.

adjudications.objection: Spectra or calcium dependence could establish a productive iminium state, exact zero activity or direct metal catalysis.
adjudications.evidence: Figure1 enamine vs p564 imine/iminium; Figure7 caption/prose mismatch; Figure8 blue trace omitted from caption; EDTA in no-calcium arm.
adjudications.decision: Keep full-length L105K panelA and CaM/L105K analogue pair separately scoped; preserve source labels, null rates/bond order and no direct catalytic metal claim.

adjudications.objection: HPLC wording claimed calibrated integration without the source describing calibration.
adjudications.evidence: p569 HPLC Methods says integrated absorbance corrected for different extinction coefficients.
adjudications.decision: Use that exact procedural scope; no independently reprocessed or calibrated chromatograms are claimed.

adjudications.objection: A bounded RA61 scout could imply exhaustive absence or restart a closed acquisition batch.
adjudications.evidence: Same batch requests46-52; Raymond primary is CaM, not RA61; R/S onp568 is docking.
adjudications.decision: Stop at first primary identity mismatch, retain compact bounded unavailable result, then use the newly acquired source for a different control question. No renamed budget or repeated Jiang/DERA/Xue routes.

reuse: Existing provider, background, parameter, ratio and context consumers recover the new control chain and the original RA61 component evidence. No runtime/schema change. Chemical-intervention arithmetic is deliberately not generalized from this case; source representation/curation remains manual and no time-saving/design-performance result is measured.
